newsitem.title: USA: AT&T may sell LIN Television stake.
newsitem.headline: AT&T may sell LIN Television stake.

text.p: AT&T Corp. said Monday that it was assessing its investment in LIN Television Corp., which could lead to the sale of all or a portion of the 13.5 million shares of LIN it holds.

AT&T spokesman Jim Byrnes said the telecommunications giant owns 45.4 percent of LIN Television, an owner and manager of television stations in 10 cities. At Monday's closing price AT&T's LIN holding would be valued at about $562 million.
Lin stock rose 62.5 cents to $41.625 on Nasdaq Monday.
AT&T also outlined its plans in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing and notified LIN's board of directors about the evaluation of the investment, Byrnes said.

AT&T said it acquired a partial stake in LIN Television through its acquisition of McCaw Cellular Communications Inc. At the time, McCaw Cellular indirectly held a majority of LIN Television common shares, AT&T said.
AT&T stock rose 62.5 cents to $39.25 on the New York Stock Exchange.
